Name: Heartbeat
Author: themattfiles
Description:
Plays an audible heartbeat sound when player's life total is below a certain configurable threshold (45% by default).

Config options:

[code]{
  "HeartBeatEnabled": true,
  "HeartBeatAlertPercent": 45.0
  "HeartBeatHeartRate": 80.0
}[/code]

[code]HeartBeatHeartRate[/code] - [i]Boolean[/i] - True / False - Enables or disables the mod.

[code]HeartBeatAlertPercent[/code] - [i]Float[/i] - The percent of health when beating heart sound should start.

[code]HeartBeatHeartRate[/code] - [i]Float[/i] - The base human heart rate to calculate heartbeat with.[code][/code]

View progress or report bugs: [url=https://github.com/embolden/Heartbeat]https://github.com/embolden/Heartbeat[/url]
